name: EvidenceChart
description: One finding beside one chart: eyebrow, headline, explanation and takeaway with a Chart drawn from the supplied series; split, full-width or compact layouts.
whenToUse: When a chart carries a specific finding. Adopt Chart first (this section composes it). Use 'split' for the standard finding-beside-chart beat, 'full' for the two or three charts that lead the argument, 'compact' when several charts follow each other. Series roles come from the brand's chart theme; the brand's device around the plot comes through the chartFrame slot. NOT for a table of exact values (EvidenceTable) and NOT for one headline number (StatBand).
